statements.t: The Company is updating its outlook for full year 2026 to reflect the impact of the voluntary recall of the Tractor Wheels product lines on Q4.
Outlook is based on information as of today, November 12, 2026, and may be impacted by factors outside the Company’s control.

The Company is unable to provide a reconciliation for forward-looking outlook of Adjusted EBITDA to net income (loss), the most closely comparable GAAP measure without unreasonable effort, because certain material reconciling items, such as depreciation and amortization, interest expense, interest income, and provision for income tax, cannot be estimated due to factors outside of the Company’s control and could…
The live audio webcast will be accessible in the “IR Calendar” section of the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.onceuponafarmorganics.com or directly here .

The Company believes that Adjusted EBITDA provides meaningful supplemental information regarding its operating performance and facilitates internal comparisons of its historical operating performance on a more consistent basis by excluding certain items that may not be indicative of its business, results of operations, or outlook.

dropped.t: We will provide background on the situation and outline our plans to manage through it, on to an eventual recovery in this important part of our business.
Fortunately, we are not aware of any reported injuries, but as would be expected, this was a scary event for both the parent and the child.
We are grateful for that acknowledgement and will continue to put consumers first by making information and next steps easy to understand and execute.
promptly and personally, and we will adapt based on the needs of those affected.

We are humbled and appreciative of the support we’ve received from our retail partners, who have told us they look forward to seeing Tractor Wheels back on their shelves as soon as this is all resolved in the appropriate manner.
We have engaged a third party to assess our products; we will evaluate our options based on those findings.

In parallel, we are preparing production plans to support a return to shelf as soon as possible, once the review is complete and any necessary changes that assure the product meets our high standards for safety have been implemented and validated.
It is still too early to offer a reliable estimate of the total costs we expect to incur, or the insurance recovery; we will provide an update as soon as practical.
We cannot yet predict whether or when any recovery will be obtained.
We have taken the steps I outlined because as a leading childhood nutrition brand, trust is our number one asset, and we will always place consumer safety first.
We understand this will be a challenging period; we also know that we will manage through it.
We will continue to take the steps needed to address the recall and earn the trust families place in us.
